title: sfx-engine recipe
description: A gamesounds sfx-engine recipe: a few hundred bytes of JSON that render to the same PCM everywhere. `model: "graph"` is the low-level node graph; any other `model` names a high-level parametric model (see docs/GAMESOUNDS-ENGINE.md and packages/sfx-engine/src/presets/*), which compiles to a graph internally before rendering.

model.description: "graph" for a low-level recipe (params must be a GraphRecipeParams), or a high-level model id such as "impact", "footstep", "ui-click" (see the model registry's own metadata for the full list and each model's own param schema).

params.description: For model "graph": { duration, nodes, output, pan? } - see graphRecipeParams below. For a named high-level model: that model's own parameters, documented in its metadata (packages/sfx-engine/src/presets/*).

seed.description: A 32-bit unsigned integer. Two recipes that differ only by seed are variants of the same idea.

ref.description: Patches another node's rendered output into this parameter (control-rate modulation): an envelope into an oscillator's freq, a sweep into a filter's cutoff, and so on.

output.description: The node id whose output becomes the recipe's signal.

inputs.description: Audio-rate signal inputs (not modulation - those go through a params field's {ref}).
